title: finding(plugin-detail): the `record:details` H1 dedupe only matches a collapsed `titleFormat` against a fixed candidate list — a template that collapses onto any other field prints that field's row right under an H1 showing the same value
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat #1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from objectui#9436's dev report (PR objectui#10358, `out_of_scope_findings`, class a). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Fact

`record:details` hides the field row that the page H1 already shows, so the name is not printed twice. For an object whose H1 comes from a rendered `titleFormat`, the dedupe matches the rendered template's value only against a candidate list:
- the name pointer;
- the derived name field;
- six literal field names.

A template that collapses onto a field outside that list is not recognised. The H1 shows that field's value, and the field's own row still prints directly under it.

## Measured

This was measured by the objectui#9436 dev while retargeting a lit control.

- **Fixture:** an object with NO declared name pointer, fields `contract_no` / `name` / `amount`, and `titleFormat: "{contract_no} - {name}"`.
- **Trigger:** a record whose `name` is blank. The template collapses onto `contract_no`.
- **Result:** the H1 reads `HT-2026-003` while the 「Contract No」 row still prints `HT-2026-003`.
- **Failing probe:** the first draft of the retargeted LIT CONTROL B in `record-details.titleFormatNoDedupe-8351.test.tsx`, which failed with `expected span to be null`.

The template-scan code that decides this is unchanged by objectui#10358, so the defect is reachable on `main` today on any `titleFormat`-only object whose template collapses onto a non-candidate field.

## Seam

`spec:ObjectSchema.titleFormat` → `renderer:record:details` H1 dedupe (the template-scan branch).

## ⛔ Not claimed

- ⛔ No fix is chosen. Matching the collapsed value against every placeholder field the template names is one option. Whether a collapsed template should be the H1 at all is another; see the objectui#9436 order and the ADR-0079 deprecation of `titleFormat`.
- ⛔ This is not a regression from objectui#10358. That PR's declared-pointer branch runs first and does not touch this scan.
- ⛔ `record-details.tsx` is currently touched by open PRs objectui#10279 and objectui#10358. Serialise behind them.

## Dedupe words

`record:details dedupe titleFormat collapse` · `H1 dedupe candidate list placeholder field` · `titleFormat collapsed duplicate row`
